== Consolation results source notes ==

The Saturday and Sunday consolation standings were added from the complete forum posts [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=18352 Saturday] and [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=18322 Sunday]. The earlier preservation cache stopped both posts at 4,000 characters. Complete originals and exact normalized-prefix comparisons are independently backed under SWCCG Work task #626.

The Saturday standings list [[Joe Olson]] at 4 (+9), while the same post's later command-card transcription says 4 (−12). The article follows the numbered standings list and records the disagreement here. The Sunday post's initial handle list intermixes dropped players; the article follows its later explicitly numbered full-name standings, retaining the dropped notes.

Printed variants Jeff Johns, Steve Yeager, Dave Runyon, Joe Strelechii, Nicolae Borata and Pat Ziagos link to the existing [[Jeffrey Johns]], [[Steve Yaeger]], [[David Runyon]], [[Joe Streleckis]], [[Nicolae Borota]] and [[Patrick Ziagos]] articles. Original spellings remain unchanged in the source copies. No player identity was inferred from a photograph.

The five existing gallery captions were shortened to linked people and event/context under the current caption standard. Image files, framing and gallery membership were unchanged. One original caption names an opponent only as Hollingsworth; the concise caption now names only [[Nate Meeker]]. The original filename retains that source context.
